actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.generate-answer.description: Generates an answer from a Dashworks bot.
actions.generate-answer.props.botId.desc: You can find this by going to Dashworks > Bots, clicking on an existing Bot, and using the 'Copy Bot ID' button on the top right.
actions.generate-answer.props.inlineSour: When true (default), sources will be cited inline in markdown formatting within the answer text.When false, the answer will not contain inline citations.
actions.generate-answer.props.message.de: The message (e.g., a question or prompt) that you want a response to.
auth.description: You can obtain API key from [API Settings](https://web.dashworks.ai/admin/api-keys).
